parts.t: [screaming] FUCK! [furious] You have a fuck ass pimple on your nose.
[enraged] So you pop it the fuck off your nose!
[angry] But wait... the same pimple keeps showing up. [furious] Now it's on your cheek!
[enraged] Fuck it, pop it again! [angry sarcasm] Great. Now it's on your chin.
[furious] You keep popping this goddamn pimple but it keeps showing up everywhere! Your face, your legs, your back...
[angry] And it keeps getting bigger and bigger! Now it's the size of a pickup truck. [seething] Right on your ass... fucking... great.
[furious] So you climb your fat ass onto the roof of your house and jump, hoping to pop this...
[screaming] FUCKING PIMPLE THAT WON'T GO AWAY!
[angry] It doesn't pop, you dumbass! You bounce around like a dumbass! [furious] Pimple basketball!
[enraged] All the way across town, onto the fucking highway... and a truck hauling safety pins, of all things, is coming your way!
[screaming] BOOM! [furious] A needle pops your fat ass butt pimple, and the explosion is so violent it flies your ass across town...
[angry] right back into your house. [relieved] No more pimple.
